glosses: Obsolete spelling of auftun which was deprecated in 1902 following the Second Orthographic Conference of 1901.

examples.text: Er stand still und betrachtete es voll Erstaunen, dann redete er es an und sprach „wer bist du? warum sitzest du hier in der Einöde?“ Es gab aber keine Antwort, denn es konnte seinen Mund nicht aufthun.
examples.translation: He stood still and looked at it in astonishment, then spoke to it and said “who are you? why are you sitting here in the wilderness?” But there was no answer, for it could not opan its mouth.
examples.english: He stood still and looked at it in astonishment, then spoke to it and said “who are you? why are you sitting here in the wilderness?” But there was no answer, for it could not opan its mouth.
